Part 1-First Experiment
Description: Hello Ladies and gents it's been a while for 2d art commission about headless sci fi and new addition to the trope about regeneration of a new body complete also introducing my Male Mad scientist OC named Dr.Hans Krazeski a lonely yet a genius mad scientist that created a machine that can regenerate a full body and resurrect a person from a piece of flesh or a dismembered limb into a newly regenerated body this idea was inspired from hitori madness club's peach comic that i saw years ago and i love it. so why not mix the rare headless genre with a new body regeneration as an addition into one trope. anyways let's begin

the backstory of the commission is when Dr.Hans Krazeski is heading home at night from buying hardware parts to complete his Artificial Reincarnation Device(A.R.D) stumbles a random neighbor girl named melissa on the sidewalk ahead of him in a remote area near his home and hidden laboratory then a sudden saw blade flies into melissa and decapitated her in front of him but as soon he sees it it did not began to panic or shock but critically think it was a chance to see her as a first specimen to his experiment as he got her decapitated corpse and severed head urgently to his secret lab at his home then he installed a controlling cap into the headless body of the decapitated girl and became his new companion and assistant while completing the ARD with few parts and completely done as he put the melissa's severed head in the ARD machine and immediately conduct his first experiment but quite unsure if it work but when the machine in motion at work Dr.Krazeski discovered that it regenerates the bone structure of the new body as well as organs in a normal speed pace then the muscles and skin last as the severed head grows a new body her heart begins to pump and beat and a gasp of air coming in and out of her lungs as he sees this he excitedly rejoiced to his creation as and experiment was a success she's come back to life and unconscious for now as the headless body of the former severed head now plays with herself to relief under orders by Dr. krazeski. after that hours later Dr.krazeski put her in a bed in her room on the next house from his house and awaken on her new regenerated body without recollecting her memory about her decapitation as hours before dr. krazeski removed her memory like a video file that scans her head after she is regenerated and revived at his lab. from then on he enjoyed the fruits of his labors and got a new assistant and companion from the headless body of melissa looking forward for another creation and experiment. the end

My OC's name was made up with hans(german name) and His last name was a homage to an old gurochan artist named "kraze"

Part 2- Cyrus's Fun Vengeance
Hello ladies and Gents here's a another treat for a sci-fi headless genre and a follow up from "Headless Tasha","Headless Lin" and "Lovey Dovey Headless Isabella" this is also the final advance wars days of ruin headless series. then after that going to a new headless characters and series if i can and must

Backstory: Before the battle of the nest dr.caulder prepared another cyrus clone and transferred his consciousness and memory into the new clone incase if he died in battle. and he did died after being defeated by Will and his crew of 12th Battalion. after the war tabitha survived the ordeal and went to a secret room from where the cyrus clone was and believing that she could get a servant for herself as she drained the water and opened. expecting a servant for herself but realized that this is not the cyrus she know but her father caulder in cyrus's clone body and got herself captured,sedated and experimented to become headless. meanwhile penny was away from a 12th battallion camp wondering alone only to be captured by remaining IDS Agents and they replaced her with a same clone to spy on them. as penny wakes up from her life support she look at her sister's headless body as well as her own being controlled by new cyrus.

Penny: Sister? what is cyrus is doing?

Tabitha: P-Penny!? you're awake and that is not cyrus anymore its's father in a new clone body.

Cyrus: Tabitha's right my dear penny it is i caulder in new cyrus's body and it seems you two failed me and i'll punish you two for not stopping those do gooders from my plans!.

Tabitha: B-But father we tried to stop them. and you should be my servant and not me instead.

Cyrus: Do not Interupt! my dear and it's marvelous to see your headless bodies moving with my command from this remote control device also motor and sensory still works and also your servered heads are still alive by through a life support of my design with no problems and my works of scientific research and discovery is....Fascinating

Penny: this looks fun tee hee hee. my body is played by daddy tee hee hee.

Tabitha: oh penny you're still you..Ugh, my body being used like this is embarrasing..

(that's it end of the story.)

description: this commissioned piece is rare headless genre that was the user would use the headless body to be remotely controlled and the servered head was kept alive in a life support system. this was inspired from artists way back from g-chan and today from pixiv.

Part 3- Headless Interrogation
Hello ladies and gentlemen It's been a while since i commissioned about headless life support genre but i wanted to make it back with more commissions of it. here we are my NSA agent OC Aki nakasone first time in a 2d artwork form. also in this commissioned artwork showed aki was on a field work "interrogating" a very important person whose great importance for intelligence also to keep the VIP from knowing everything he was blindfolded and put on headphones talking and questioning him while aki's head looking at the monitor for survailance of the interrogation as she fully control her own body for a duration of time from the next room giving him "intense" procedure on the target to gain more information.

Part 4- Headless Interrogation 2.
Hello Ladies and Gents It's been a while since i commissioned about one of my Original Characters Being Headless and in Life Support sci fi genre again anyways this Commissioned artwork is a sequel of it with two of my OCs in their original design when i created them from koikatsu.

a little backstory is the FBI and CIA Agents tracked down and captured a very important person who have very good knowledge of bioengineering with his inventions of gadgets never seen before. during his capture she was interrogated by agent named Stacey O'Connell with the Help of An FBI Agent Named Erlinda Masangkay who have lost a bet due to inter-service rivalry and doing on how to use the device and volunteered herself in this interrogation method of extracting information.

Part 5- Metal Slug Yumna Cosplay
Hello, ladies and Gents, i am glad to post this commissioned artwork about an Indonesian Chinese girl named Yumna from a first animated Indonesian movie battle of Surabaya last year i have a crush on this character ever since however in this commission she is a modern-day reincarnation of her and now an adult as well she is cosplaying metal slug style uniform with her national colors of Indonesian flag. as an fellow south east asian from the Philippine islands really hits me home when watching the movie even i now lived in the land of liberty.
